episodes.title: Ashley Winstead on How Powerful Women Can End Up in Cults
episodes.description:
Ambition and intelligence are supposed to be armor. Ashley Winstead explains why they can be exactly the opening a cult looks for, and how that idea works its way into her fiction.

Watch the full interview - Ashley Winstead on Revenge Writing, Cults, and Toxic Ambition:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BbXK4DgJOho

Talking Horror is a weekly interview show with horror and thriller authors, hosted by Rachel Redd. New episodes every week.
